method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the employee, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); dates in one module, the rules and exported questions in another, the cases in a third; one regulative rule (s 12(4), (6)(a), PARTY ... MUST ... WITHIN ... HENCE FULFILLED LEST BREACH BY ... BECAUSE) run by EVALTRACE inside an exported question that takes only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Long Service Leave Act 1976 (Tas), No. 95 of 1976, consolidated version published 2025-01-22 and current at point in time 2026-11-06, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/act-1976-095.txt (text sha256 1a307bdca44dc690618860b593f9fb26a20039fcbcd256d9f914deaab024b374), retrieved from legislation.tas.gov.au on 2026-11-06. No regulations under the Act are deposited; the Act's own figures do not depend on them.

seat: the employee or former employee to whom the Act gives long service leave (taslsl-employee.l4); the questions a death raises (s 9) are asked from the seat of the deceased employee's personal representative
focus: one of the state long service leave Acts the Fair Work Act leaves in place: the whole operative Act

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run taslsl-dates.l4 ; l4 run taslsl-employee.l4 ; l4 run taslsl-cases.l4
checks.result: 154 assertions written, 154 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file; 3 #TRACEs (1 fulfilled, 2 breached) as their expect lines say (2026-11-07); two deliberately wrong assertions in a scratch file showed as failed
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: The whole operative Act. In: s 2(1) definitions, s 2(2); s 2A(1) and Schedule 2; s 3; s 5(1)-(10); s 7(1) (as an input); s 7A; s 8(1)-(3A); s 8A(1)-(3A); s 9; s 10; s 11(1)-(8); s 12(1)-(6), (10) (s 12(9) in descriptions); s 13(1) (with s 13(1A)-(4) and s 14 in the description); s 14A; s 15(1), (3); s 20(1) penalty; s 21; s 23 (in a description). Out: ss 1, 2A(2), 4, 19, 22, 24 (machinery); s 6 (pre-1976 employment); s 7(2)-(8) (the Secretary's exemption procedure); s 8(4), s 8A(4) (employment before 1964 / the 1980 proclaimed date; dates not deposited); s 12(7), (8); s 16; s 18, s 20(1)(a), (2) (the employer's record offences); ss 25-27 and Schedule 3 (transitional, historic). Reasons in NOTES.md.

subjects/au/tas/limitation-act-1974 (not imported; s 15(1) of this Act sets its own 3-year reach)
